en.description: Turn seller-supplied nutrition facts into one nutrition panel still per SKU. This nutrition panel art studio lays out the seller-supplied serving and nutrient lines as a nutrition facts label and nutrition panel graphic. Use it for food nutrition labels, packaging nutrition art, and product-page nutrition charts.

en.title: Nutrition Panel Art: One Still Per SKU
